description: List the rows of a background record import that ended in one status, in row order. Use status invalid or failed to see why rows were refused: each carries `row` (its position in the uploaded array, from 1), `message` and the uploaded `data` (null for a row that was too large to upload). Written rows (created, updated, unchanged) carry `recordId` and no data. Pass `nextAfter` back as `after` for the next page; it is null on the last one.

after.description: The previous page's nextAfter: return rows numbered above it

limit.description: Rows per page, at most 200 (the default)

status.description: Which rows to list: invalid (refused by validation) and failed (refused when written) carry a message and the uploaded data; created, updated and unchanged carry the recordId; pending is not validated yet, valid waits to be written

name: list_record_import_rows
title: List record import rows
